review_summary: Strict independent external audit confirms 100% compliance of 9702_w19_42 Question 5 (10 marks total) against primary QP pages 13–15 and MS page 8. Part (a)(i) accurately assesses the definition of specific acoustic impedance as the product of density and speed of sound in the medium (2 marks: M1, A1). Part (a)(ii) verifies calculation of bone acoustic impedance Z_B = (1.8 × 10^3 kg m^-3) × (4.1 × 10^3 m s^-1) = 7.4 × 10^6 kg m^-2 s^-1 (1 mark: A1). Part (b) evaluates intensity reflection coefficient α = (1.7 - 1.3)^2 / (1.7 + 1.3)^2 = 0.018 and transmitted fraction 1 - α = 0.98 across the fat-muscle interface using Fig. 5.2 data (1 mark: A1). Part (c)(i) evaluates the definition of ultrasound attenuation as the reduction in power or intensity of the wave as it travels through a medium (2 marks: M1, A1). Part (c)(ii) evaluates exponential attenuation I / I_0 = e^(-μx) across 0.45 cm fat giving ratio 0.90 (or 0.898) and 2.1 cm muscle giving ratio 0.62 (or 0.617) (3 marks: C1, A1, A1). Part (d) verifies the overall transmitted fraction entering fat and leaving muscle as the continuous product 0.898 × 0.982 × 0.617 = 0.54 (or 0.55) (1 mark: A1). All 6 leaf parts include >=2 non-giveaway progressive hints, complete step-by-step teacher walkthroughs, correct schema control bindings, and 100% official marking-point parity.
